doc: Cloud objects of a patch: mask = patch > 0.5 (strict), scipy.ndimage.label with its default structure, 4-CONNECTIVITY (edge neighbours only: two texels that touch diagonally are two objects; no wraparound), area = texel count * patch_px_km^2 (77.0252 km^2 per texel); returns (share of the cloudy area held by objects larger than 1e5 km^2, median object area in km^2), and (0.0, 0.0) when there is no object. A float32 patch with one 15-texel object (1155 km^2): big = 0, the median is its own area. The mask compares in float32 (0.5 is exact in both). Diagnostics recomputed by the case through the same label call, not returned by the function: n_objects and areas_km2 (in ndimage.label order: by the raster position of each object's first texel); a port's labelling must produce the same multiset of areas. Integer counts times a float64 constant: exact up to the rounding of a product and a sum, 1e-9.
